concept.name: Gudmundsson Example 3-1 (Cessna 162 Skycatcher) — ADRpy input
concept.source: Gudmundsson, General Aviation Aircraft Design, 2nd ed., Example 3-1, Sec. 3.2.2, PDF p.109-111 (printed p.64-66). Inputs converted to SI/ADRpy units; see notes.
notes: AR=8, S=120 ft^2, W0=1320 lbf, CDmin=0.0333, CLmaxTO=1.756, CLTO=0.5, CDTO=0.038, mu=0.04 as given in the example.
Ground run 640 ft = 195.07 m; climb 880 fpm at VY=66.04 KCAS at S-L; turn n=1.155 at 108 KTAS and 8000 ft = 2438.4 m; cruise 108 KTAS at 8000 ft.
Service ceiling: the brief states 15,000 ft but STEP 7 evaluates the density ratio at 17,000 ft (5181.6 m). 17,000 ft is used here to reproduce STEP 7; the inconsistency is in the source.
CLmaxclean=1.68 (actual C-162 clean value quoted in STEP 3); vstallclean 45 KCAS = LSA limit shown in Fig. 3-3.
Propeller efficiencies 0.60 take-off, 0.65 climb, 0.75 cruise (given); turn 0.75 and service ceiling 0.65 are assumptions of this file, not of the example.
Gudmundsson uses e=0.8106 (k=0.04909); ADRpy computes its own induced-drag factor, so values are expected to differ.
